title: Incident response for an LLM application

videos.script: At three minutes past two on a Friday, the canary alert pages. A reply quoted the system prompt, and the system prompt holds the payments key. {{page}} The runbook was written in daylight, and it says what is safe to do now. Revoke the key first. Find out how it leaked afterwards. {{runbook}} Blast says what revoking breaks: the refunds, for thirteen minutes. And who used the key: an address that is not ours read two payment records. {{blast}} The payout it tried after that was refused. The key had been revoked seven minutes earlier. {{refused}} Detected eleven minutes after it started, contained twenty-eight minutes after that. Every step written down with its time. {{timeline}} Personal data was read, so the ANPD has to be told within three working days. On a Friday before a holiday, that is Thursday. {{deadline}} And the review asks how it became possible, never who is to blame. {{review}}
